summary: WeShop Holdings (Jersey FPI, Nasdaq-listed) filed a 6-K disclosing a September 9, 2026 Ordinary Shares Purchase Agreement and Registration Rights Agreement with Roth Principal Investments, LLC for up to $25,000,000 of newly issued Class A ordinary shares. The structure is an at-the-market-style equity purchase facility (US equivalent: an equity line of credit/standby equity purchase agreement), with the company controlling timing and no obligation to sell, subject to a Threshold Price and Form F-1 resale registration effectiveness. Term runs up to 36 months from Commencement; pricing is VWAP-based across Market Open, Intraday, Pre-Market, or Post-Market Purchases. Watch dilution, registration effectiveness timing, Threshold Price floors, and any warrant or fee overhang; secondary overhang is the key risk-arb angle, with no fixed deal terms stated.
